scientific_question: Does the frozen prediction-domain and minimal numerical-identifiability framework transfer from cubic/cubic Hahn1 and Thurber to the different quadratic/quadratic NIST Kirby2 model?

selection_scope.selection_rationale: Five-parameter quadratic/quadratic rational model with 151 observations, chosen to test a different polynomial degree rather than retune the earlier cubic/cubic failures
selection_scope.prospective_meaning: Dataset-prospective computational validation, not an independent experiment or external preregistration

data.name: NIST/ITL StRD Kirby2
data.units_as_published: Observed scanning electron microscope line-width standard data; preserve published y and x without invented conversion or uncertainty

model.bounds: Unbounded coefficients as published by NIST; denominator admissibility is evaluated separately
model.optimizer: scipy.optimize.curve_fit with method=lm, maxfev=200000, full_output=true; select the lowest training residual sum of squares

fold_rule.construction: Sort unique x values into five contiguous, nearly equal groups; repeated x values never cross fitting and test sets; every observation is evaluated once
fold_rule.baseline: Ordinary least-squares quadratic polynomial fitted only on the other four groups, selected from the published quadratic/quadratic model degree before seeing outcomes
fold_rule.retuning: No start, model, threshold or fold changes after seeing test results

prediction_domain_gate.real_root_rule: numpy.roots for 1+b4*x+b5*x^2; absolute imaginary part below 1e-8; reject numerical real roots inside the closed held-out x interval
prediction_domain_gate.dense_grid_rule: Evaluate 1001 evenly spaced points spanning each closed held-out interval; reject non-finite values, exact zeros or denominator sign changes
prediction_domain_gate.observation_rule: Every held-out prediction and denominator must be finite and every held-out denominator must be nonzero
prediction_domain_gate.scope: Numerical admissibility on the held-out interval, not an exact algebraic proof outside it

minimal_numerical_identifiability_gate.jacobian: Analytic training Jacobian at the frozen fit
minimal_numerical_identifiability_gate.column_scaling: Euclidean-norm column scaling before singular-value analysis
minimal_numerical_identifiability_gate.rank_rule: Require numerical rank 5 using tolerance max(matrix shape)*machine_epsilon*largest_scaled_singular_value
minimal_numerical_identifiability_gate.covariance_rule: Local linearized parameter standard errors must be finite and positive using pseudo-inverse rcond=1e-12
minimal_numerical_identifiability_gate.diagnostics_not_gates: Report scaled condition number and maximum absolute off-diagonal parameter correlation without retrospective cutoffs
minimal_numerical_identifiability_gate.scope: Minimal local numerical check only; full rank does not prove global structural identifiability or physical endogeneity

decision_rules.fold_gated_limited_support: Prediction-domain admissible AND minimal numerical identifiability AND held-out RMSE <= quadratic-baseline held-out RMSE
decision_rules.overall_all_folds_gated_support: All five folds satisfy fold_gated_limited_support; otherwise retain every failure
decision_rules.interpretation: Dataset-specific computational limited support, never a universal law or independent experimental replication

full_fit_certification_rule.purpose: Known-answer implementation check only; never used as held-out evidence
